svg.title: Illustrative cost per accepted mission
svg.desc: Hypothetical USD inputs, unrelated to Dive-LD. Baseline 17000 dollars per attempt divided by 80 percent acceptance equals 21250 dollars. Lower acceptance at 60 percent equals approximately 28333 dollars. Additional recovery expense gives 18000 dollars divided by 90 percent, or 20000 dollars. No observed vendor results.

g.text: Cost per accepted mission = (O + L + R + D) / p
O operating cost · L incremental loss · R incremental recovery · D interruption · p acceptance
A higher recovery bill can support a lower cost per accepted result.
All inputs are invented. No procurement quote, reliability estimate or vendor ranking.
13 SEP 2026 · AUTHORED SENSITIVITY · COST CATEGORIES MUST AVOID DOUBLE COUNTING
